title: Bloomfield, Hollymount, Hollymount, Co. Mayo, F12CH79
seoTitle: Bloomfield, Hollymount, Hollymount, Co. Mayo, F12CH79
description:
We a privileged to bring this refurbished detached bungalow house to the market. It is in Bloomfield Hollymount, less than 1.6km from Hollymount village of the Hollymount/Ballinrobe road, less than 10 minutes from Ballinrobe Town. Ballinrobe Golf course is just 6km from this property.

Accommodation includes entrance porch, spacious sitting/living room, two double bedrooms, both en-suite, kitchen/dining room, and spacious hot press. The property stands on a large 1.5-acre site with a stone out-building to the rear of the property and a separate domestic shed. 

Services are provided by mains water supply, electric/telecom services, septic tank, percolation sewerage system, air to water heating system.

The house is tastefully decorated with fitted kitchen units, floor covering. Outside lawns are leveled and seeded with an extensive rear garden.
